title: Chapter 388 During The Battle Of Guide Mansion
content:
Chapter 388 During The Battle Of Guide Mansion

With reinforcements from the provincial capital, Guide Mansion's strength suddenly became stronger, and it even had an absolute advantage in the face of the monster soldiers on the opposite side.

Although the demon soldiers on the opposite side are called monsters, in fact, they are just a group of humanoid creatures with rougher skin and thicker flesh than ordinary humans.

Most of their strength is only around the third rank, and they don't have much advantage compared to the regular armies of the major dynasties.

Even because of their intelligence and nature, they are far inferior to the regular human army in terms of discipline. When the strength and numbers are the same, the soldiers of these monster races are often defeated.

The strength of Guidefu City before, if there is no sixth-order powerhouse to support the field, the high-end combat power is not equal.

Just one soldier from Guide Mansion can fight against 30,000 demon soldiers on the opposite side. It is not certain who will win and who will lose!

It's different now, the governor personally led the army to fight against the rebellion, and the governor with the same level of cultivation in terms of high-level combat power dealt with the Huangshan Demon King. The strength of the remaining soldiers is more than twice that of the demon soldiers on the opposite side, and they have the upper hand. It seems that the outcome of this war has been decided at this moment.

"Huangshan Demon King, retreat now, I don't have to hold you accountable!"

The Governor of Dongjiang Province, Qin Ming, stood in mid-air. With his level of cultivation, even warriors could stand in the void and fly at will.

And the Huangshan demon king opposite him is a weasel at the foot of Huangshan Mountain in the forest of thousands of miles. After practicing for thousands of years, he reached the sixth level of strength and officially became a demon king.

"Hey, I don't want to see what kind of goods you are if I ask my king to retreat."

The Huangshan demon king laughed a few times, and looked contemptuously at the opposite Governor Qin Ming with extreme disdain.

"Don't bully people too much, you and I are both sixth-order powerhouses, with the same cultivation level, it's hard to say who will win and who will lose in a real fight."

Qin Ming cursed inwardly, feeling extremely angry at the Huangshan demon king's overreaching, especially his contemptuous eyes, even the emperor of the Ming Dynasty dared not do this, how could he not feel insulted to his self-esteem.

But what he said just now is indeed true. Both sides are at the sixth level of strength. In a fight, it is unpredictable who wins and who loses.

With their current strength, even if the human lifespan is short, they still have a lifespan of more than a thousand years, and there is a lot of glory and wealth waiting to be enjoyed.

How dare they be on this battlefield, for the sake of the so-called Ming Dynasty, Li people lost their lives in vain, they are not so noble yet.

That's why Qin Ming is here to persuade them that there is such an unwritten agreement between these powerhouses above the sixth level.

"There are conflicts between each other, and they can be resolved through discussion, and they will never fight for their lives."

Unless the two sides have a life-and-death enmity, everything is easy to discuss. This is a tacit understanding for countless years.

This is also the reason why Qin and Ming didn't think about fighting before, but instead thought about compromising with the enemy.

"Jie Jie Jie, just because you also want to be compared with this king, today is your death day."

An even more terrifying strange smile appeared from the mouth of Huangshan King, which made people's hearts tremble.

Although Qin Ming on the opposite side was even more annoyed when he heard this, he opened his mouth, as if he wanted to persuade him again, but he didn't expect that the Huangshan Demon King opened his mouth and used his natal supernatural power directly.

A dense yellow mist sprayed out, and the smoke billowed directly towards Qin Ming's body, extremely fast.

Qin Ming was about to persuade him just now, but it was expected that the Demon King of Huangshan would move his hands so repeatedly. Unexpectedly, although he had quickly taken precautions, he was still covered by the smoke.

Qin Ming just fell into the yellow mist when a burst of pungent stench came to his nostrils. He was so dizzy that he felt a tumbling sensation in his internal organs, and couldn't help but vomited.

It is rumored that this weasel has a natal supernatural power when it attains enlightenment, which is the condensation of the filthy aura in their stomachs. It is not very obvious when it comes to killing power, but it is very powerful in weakening the enemy.

This filthy air can stun people's minds, destroy people's blood, and hurt people's internal organs, so that a person loses the strength to fight before fighting, and has to be arrested with nothing but hands.

Well, having said so much, maybe others don't quite know what supernatural power is, but in the final analysis, it is simpler and more popular.

It's just that the weasel holds a fart in its stomach, and puts all the filth gathered by eating, drinking and scattering into that fart. After a long time, the ecstasy feels needless to say.

If it is suddenly released towards oneself during the battle, ninety-nine out of 10 people will be stunned by this fart and poisoned by its fart.

Even if you are lucky enough to carry it down, you will be disgusted by this fart, have scruples in your heart, and your combat effectiveness will be greatly weakened.

Therefore, this is indeed a very useful supernatural power, but it is a bit too insidious and obscene.

But for these monsters, as long as they can win, a little notoriety is nothing at all.

In their monster race, the strong are respected, and the victor is king. As long as you can win, no matter what method you use, you can get their respect and follow.

This Qin Ming is like this now, he himself is a strong martial artist, his facial features are extremely sharp, and he is extremely sensitive to any aura.

Caught off guard, being narrated by this stinky fart will turn the world upside down, disgusting to death.

Originally, with the control of the body by a martial arts expert, even though these stinky farts are quite unpleasant and extremely disgusting, Qin Ming can shrink every pore of his body and seal them all to prevent the stinky farts from entering.

But who let the weasel pick the timing too well, and made a surprise attack when Qin Ming took it lightly and didn't take precautions.

This made him fall for it all at once.

There was no time for the pores of his body to close, and the nose did not have time to block his breathing, all the stench mixed with the air and entered his body.

Not only did they stink to death, they were disgusting to death, the poison in the stinky farts also paralyzed his body, and his reaction speed was slowed down by no less than 30%. Coupled with the weakening of various states, his strength was less than half of his prime.

The poison in this stinky fart can't be underestimated. A weasel's fart is often held back by him for tens of hundreds of years, or even hundreds of years.

After such a long time, what kind of poison can be suffocated by the filthy aura in the weasel's body, it is really scary to think about it. It's not too surprising to be able to play a role against such a sixth-level martial arts expert.

After all, it is also the natal supernatural power of a sixth-order powerhouse, and it is normal for it to be more powerful.

With Qin Ming's tricks, even on the battlefield of ordinary soldiers below, the Ming army won successively, and the monster soldiers on the opposite side lost their helmets and armor, and lost their soldiers and generals. It seems that they can't last long.

But as long as the Huangshan Demon King can get rid of Qin Ming, who is the only sixth rank, no matter how many Daming troops are below, he can wipe them all out by himself.

The situation on the battlefield was once again leaning towards the demon clan. If there were no new forces to join in, the entire Guide mansion would be completely captured by the demon king of Mount Huang, and there would be no doubt about it.

Governor Qin Ming seems to be dead, even if he can barely hold on now, it won't last long.

The only thing that can be counted on is the Ming Dynasty, and then send a sixth order to sit in charge, otherwise the entire Dongjiang Province may be corrupted and completely caught in the flames of war.
